description: This file defines the Timesheet entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_timesheet' database table. It contains properties such as id, state, startDate, endDate, and employee, along with their getters and setters. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and incorporates a decorator trait.

classes.name: Timesheet
classes.description: Entity class representing a timesheet record, with properties for ID, state, start and end dates, and associated employee, mapped to the 'ohrm_timesheet' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the timesheet.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the timesheet.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the timesheet.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the timesheet.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with the timesheet.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the timesheet.
